skills.description: This skill should be used when building or improving an AI Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) system for rolling forecasts and budgets, where the \"AI\" means statistical models FUSED with LLM qualitative injection (not naive prediction). It covers three required depths: (1) hybrid forecast — ARIMA/SARIMA + XGBoost/LightGBM baselines with quantile intervals, plus LLM semantic correction of qualitative bias (\"holiday effect underestimated by 12%\") via dynamic weighted gating; (2) rolling forecast — 12-18 month horizon that absorbs CRM signings / HR changes in real time with automatic, coherent cascade via MinT hierarchical reconciliation; (3) quantified uncertainty — every prediction ships WITH confidence intervals (quantile regression + conformal + Monte Carlo), never a single point. Trigger phrases include \"AI 财务预测\", \"滚动预算\", \"混合预测\", \"FP&A 落地\", \"MinT 协调\", \"量化不确定性\", \"LLM 语义修正\". The skill encodes verified hard content from 7 reference books (formulas, algorithms, engineering patterns) plus an honest-grading convention for synthesized parts.

Trigger phrases include "做一本双语绘本", "生成双语有声绘本", "故事线索生成绘本", "AI 绘本", "儿童双语故事", "bilingual picture book", "generate a kids storybook".
skills.description_zh:
双语有声绘本生成器面向家长与老师（创作端），服务 3–8 岁儿童（消费端）。只需给出几个线索词（如"小兔、蓝围巾、下雨、勇敢"），即可全自动产出：
1. 可翻页电子绘本（HTML）——封面 + 逐页插画、中文/英文对照文案、每页独立的中英配音播放器，支持键盘与按钮翻页，无任何外部依赖。
2. 竖屏视频绘本（MP4）——1080×1920，逐页画面 + 中英双语字幕 + 英文旁白，适配视频号/朋友圈/抖音直接分发。
工作流内置于 skill：线索采集 → 结构化故事生成（含跨页角色一致性锚点）→ 插画（ImageGen）→ 中英配音（edge-tts，中文晓晓 + 英文 Aria）→ 双形态合成（自研脚本）→ 交付。生成内容自动标注 AI 属性，符合平台合规要求。
差异化：市面上 AI 绘本工具多为单语或单形态输出；本 skill 以"双语对照 + 点读式双语播放 + 电子书/短视频双形态"一站式交付，且角色跨页一致性有专门约束设计。
